developments: Bitcoin slipped from about $61,190 at the afternoon edition to near $60,840 on Kraken at 21:30 UK, a dip of about 0.6%, after trading between roughly $60,460 and $61,340.
The Block reported that Chainflip's hack involved the theft of 122.9 BTC, taking losses to about $12 million; its 10% bounty offer runs until 18:38 UK on Monday.
Zcash held near $791, inside a range of about $784 to $800 this evening, according to Kraken.
briefing.changed: Little has moved since the afternoon. Bitcoin gave back a small part of its daytime gain but stayed above $60,000, and no market-moving macro, ETF or ZEC news broke on a Sunday evening.
briefing.question: Will Bitcoin hold above $60,000 once US stock futures reopen tonight and spot ETFs trade again on Monday, after last week's roughly $1.1 billion of withdrawals?
briefing.watch: US stock futures reopen at about 23:00 UK tonight, then US markets open at 14:30 UK on Monday. The next 🔴 event is the Fed decision on Wednesday 9 December at 19:00 UK.

lead.headline: Bitcoin holds above $60,000 as quiet weekend draws to a close
lead.standfirst: Bitcoin eased slightly on Sunday evening but kept most of its daytime rebound, with US futures due to reopen and no fresh market-moving news.
body: Bitcoin traded near $60,840 on Kraken at 21:30 UK time on Sunday, Kraken data showed, about 0.6% below its level at the afternoon edition. It moved in a narrow band between roughly $60,460 and $61,340 through the evening.

The price remained about 1% higher on the day and well above Friday's two-year low of $55,130. No single story was found to explain the evening's drift, which came with US stock and ETF markets shut for the weekend.

The Block reported that Chainflip, a cross-chain swap protocol, disclosed the theft of 122.9 BTC, bringing losses from Saturday's hack to about $12 million. Chainflip has offered the attacker a 10% bounty if the funds are returned by 18:38 UK on Monday.
Zcash traded near $791, little changed from the afternoon, according to Kraken. On the Zcash community forum, developers launched ZecLens, a dashboard tracking which software clients run the network.
US stock futures reopen at about 23:00 UK, and US markets and spot bitcoin ETFs trade again from 14:30 UK on Monday.

headline: A quiet Sunday evening: Bitcoin eased to near $60,840 but held above $60,000, and ZEC sat near $791. Chainflip's hack losses were put at 122.9 BTC; Monday's US open is the next test.
spoken: Cryptonaire Post, evening edition, Sunday the twenty second of November. A quiet evening. Bitcoin is near sixty thousand eight hundred dollars, down a little since the afternoon but still above sixty thousand and up about one percent on the day. Zcash is near seven hundred and ninety one dollars, little changed. Chainflip says one hundred and twenty three bitcoin were stolen in Saturday's hack, about twelve million dollars, and its bounty offer runs until twenty to seven on Monday evening. US stock futures reopen around eleven tonight, and US markets open at half past two tomorrow afternoon. The next big event is the Fed decision on the ninth of December at seven in the evening. Information only, not advice.

stories.title: Bitcoin eases but holds above $60,000
stories.why: Kraken showed Bitcoin slipping from about $61,190 at 16:30 UK to near $60,840 at 21:30 UK, with an evening range of about $60,460 to $61,340. The latest evidence shows the daytime rebound mostly holding into the weekly close, up about 1% on the day.

note.read: Thin Sunday trading kept price pinned near $61,000; the weekend rebound from Friday's low is intact but untested.
note.alt: A gentle evening fade could be the start of weekend gains unwinding once larger US traders return.
note.change: A drop back below $60,000 when US futures reopen, or heavy spot ETF outflows on Monday, would point to the rebound fading.

stories.title: Chainflip says 122.9 BTC taken in weekend hack
stories.why: The Block reported that Chainflip disclosed the theft of 122.9 BTC, putting total losses at about $12 million. The new detail confirms most of the loss was Bitcoin; the 10% bounty deadline is 18:38 UK on Monday. Small against the wider Bitcoin market.

note.read: A contained protocol loss with no sign of wider contagion to major venues.
note.alt: Two bridge or swap incidents in one weekend (Chainflip and Cyber) could point to a wider campaign against cross-chain infrastructure.
note.change: Evidence of the stolen BTC being moved to exchanges, or further cross-chain exploits, would raise its importance.

stories.title: ZEC steady near $791
stories.why: Kraken showed ZEC between about $784 and $800 since the afternoon edition and near $791 at 21:30 UK, against about $794 earlier. No new market-moving ZEC news.

stories.title: ZecLens dashboard tracks Zcash client diversity
stories.why: A new dashboard announced on the Zcash community forum tracks which node software runs the network. Client diversity matters as Zcash moves from the original zcashd software to Zebra; a network reliant on one client is more exposed to a single bug. Background only.

stories.title: Trump hosts another memecoin dinner with TRUMP down 99% from peak
stories.why: The Block reported that President Trump was hosting a dinner for top holders of the TRUMP memecoin on Sunday night, with the token about 99% below its peak. Fortune had reported weak take-up of the dinner places. A reminder of how far speculative tokens have fallen; no sign it moves BTC.
stories.caveat: Reports differ on how far the token is below its peak, from about 97% to 99%.

investigating: Will Monday's US session confirm the weekend rebound? Evidence: Nasdaq futures from 23:00 UK tonight, then Monday's spot ETF flows.
Will Chainflip's stolen BTC be returned or moved? Evidence: an update from Chainflip by Monday's 18:38 UK deadline, or on-chain tracking of the 122.9 BTC.
How much was taken in the Cyber bridge incident? Evidence: a loss figure from Cyber, and whether Upbit and Bithumb reopen CYBER transfers.
